items.title: 【独立创造】robots.txt 早写了，爬虫还是把我免费的 Worker 刷到 8840 次超限
items.summary: 10 月 12 号收到 Cloudflare 的邮件：过去 24 小时，Workers 有一千多次达到免费套餐的 CPU 时间上限。进后台一看，实际是 8840 次，用户那边直接 error 1102，页面打不开。 第一反应是升级付费套餐。手放到按钮上又停了一下，因为我先看了眼请求量：24 小时大概两万次，比平时高出一大截。这个量不对劲，我就想先弄清楚是谁在刷。 Workers 的指标能按脚本和状态拆开，能看到 exceededResources 那一栏。
items.content:
10 月 12 号收到 Cloudflare 的邮件：过去 24 小时，Workers 有一千多次达到免费套餐的 CPU 时间上限。进后台一看，实际是 8840 次，用户那边直接 error 1102，页面打不开。

第一反应是升级付费套餐。手放到按钮上又停了一下，因为我先看了眼请求量：24 小时大概两万次，比平时高出一大截。这个量不对劲，我就想先弄清楚是谁在刷。

Workers 的指标能按脚本和状态拆开，能看到 exceededResources 那一栏。再拉请求明细，按来源的 ASN 和「已验证爬虫」分组，答案很清楚：九成来自一家云厂商的地址段，请求头伪装成 Chrome；外加一个 AI 公司的爬虫。它们刷的全是筛选、排序页，参数组合是无穷的。

按理说这几个页面不该被爬。robots.txt 里早就写了不许带查询串的 URL 进来，它们不看。边缘缓存也帮不上忙，每个组合都是第一次见，一次都命中不了，只能完整地服务端渲染一遍，一个请求 20 到 70 毫秒 CPU。

修法没多复杂：在 Worker 入口、渲染之前，先看请求的 ASN 和已验证爬虫类别，命中就直接回 403，不到 1 毫秒。那家云厂商的 GET 全拦；AI 爬虫只拦带查询串的，普通页面还让它爬；POST 放行，别把支付回调这类 webhook 拦掉。

回头看，值得说的就两点。robots.txt 是给守规矩的爬虫看的，对不守规矩的等于没有。还有，站里只要有筛选、排序、分页这种带查询串的链接，又是全服务端渲染，上线时就得有这一层，别等邮件来了才想。我这次要是直接点了升级，等于花着钱让人继续刷。

想问下也在用 Workers 或者别的边缘函数的：按 ASN 在代码里拦，你们有更省事的做法吗？边缘 WAF 的规则够不够用？

items.title: 【独立创造】译哥 Poly：Mac 本机把视频换成另一种语言，并用原片音色配音（v 站用户送 10 个买断码）
items.summary: 我平时做视频，经常要把一条视频换成另一种语言：要么把中文视频发到海外，要么把生肉英文教程转成中文看。只翻字幕准确率堪忧，云端 AI 配音按分钟收费、声音还是那几个熟悉的「傲娇大姐孤独小帅」，自己手搓「扒词 → 翻译 → TTS → 对轨 → 压字幕」一条 5 分钟的片子能耗掉一下午。 所以我用原生 Swift 写了个 macOS 应用： 译哥 Poly 。视频拖进去点开始，不到 1 分钟出成片：换了语言、保留原片音色，双语字幕一并压好（目前中 ↔ 英）。

所以我用原生 Swift 写了个 macOS 应用：译哥 Poly。视频拖进去点开始，不到 1 分钟出成片：换了语言、保留原片音色，双语字幕一并压好（目前中 ↔ 英）。

效果（47 秒中文口播 → 英文配音成片），官网首页能直接看视频：https://poly.uulili.com

单人口播：适合你把中文视频一键做成海外版发布（反过来也行）

课程讲座翻译：产品教程可以用这种方式翻译成其他语言

快速做双语字幕：为视频快速制作自己指定样式的双语字幕

识别和配音全部在 Apple Silicon 本机跑，视频不上传。

识别：SenseVoice（sherpa-onnx）+ Silero VAD；英文、日文用系统语音识别。

翻译：整句翻译，不按碎词断句。Apple Translation（免费、本机）/ Google / DeepSeek / 智谱等多种渠道，Key 安全存入钥匙串。走云端大模型时只发字幕文本，token 用量很低。

校对：可选的校对窗口（设置里决定要不要介入），原文、配音字幕、断行都能改；支持大模型一键润色；还有术语表，自定义处理人名、品牌名这类逢听必错的词。

items.summary: 上面的终端没有与服务器通信。模型的权重下载一次，保存在浏览器的缓存中，每个令牌都由大约 52 KB 的 WebAssembly 模块在 CPU 上计算。无GPU代码，无推理API；您输入的内容和模型回答的内容永远不会离开选项卡。（来源：Show HN·独立开发者变现榜）
items.content:
上面的终端没有与服务器通信。模型的权重下载一次，保存在浏览器的缓存中，每个令牌都由大约 52 KB 的 WebAssembly 模块在 CPU 上计算。无GPU代码，无推理API；您输入的内容和模型回答的内容永远不会离开选项卡。

生成时每秒生成的令牌：相同的权重，相同的机器（Apple M3 Max，10 个性能 + 4 个效率核心）。 “此页面”是无头Chrome； llama.cpp 是本机版本 8660。测量时间为 2026 年 11 月 27 日至 28 日。

因此，浏览器在生成时的 CPU 利用率约为本机 llama.cpp 的 65-75%。读取提示是最落后的地方：llama.cpp 批量处理提示令牌（0.6B 模型为 513 tok/s），该引擎一次处理一个（大约 160 tok/s）。

Qwen3.5 型号，相同的机器和 8 个线程：2B 约为 39 tok/s，0.8B 约为 74 tok/s。这里每个参数的速度都比较慢，因为它们的词汇量更大（248,320 个标记对 151,936 个标记），而且我还没有针对 llama.cpp 对它们进行基准测试。

items.originalContent:
The terminal above is not talking to a server. The model's weights are downloaded once, kept in your browser's cache, and every token is computed on your CPU by a WebAssembly module of about 52 KB. No GPU code, no inference API; what you type and what the model answers never leave the tab.

Tokens per second while generating: same weights, same machine (Apple M3 Max, 10 performance + 4 efficiency cores). "This page" is headless Chrome; llama.cpp is native build 8660. Measured 27–28 Nov 2026.

So the browser reaches roughly 65–75% of native llama.cpp on the CPU when generating. Reading the prompt is where it is furthest behind: llama.cpp processes prompt tokens in batches (513 tok/s for the 0.6B model), this engine does them one at a time (about 160 tok/s).

The Qwen3.5 models, same machine and 8 threads: about 39 tok/s for the 2B and 74 tok/s for the 0.8B. They are slower per parameter here because their vocabulary is larger (248,320 tokens against 151,936), and I have not benchmarked them against llama.cpp.

Your own numbers appear in the terminal after every reply; type /bench for a fixed test and /numbers for the Qwen3 comparison as a chart.

Share of next-token predictions that stay identical to the full-precision model (Qwen3-0.6B, 645 tokens of mixed English, German, code and chat):

Generic compression helps little: zstd at its highest setting shrinks the 8-bit file by about 6%.

想做的事情很简单：让钓友有个地方记录出钓、交流附近的鱼情，顺便认识一些同城的人。

最近还加了同城「城主」：每城一位，负责管理留言、带动交流，可以置顶、精选、屏蔽留言，也可以建立自己的同城交流群。

小程序已经具备开通广告的能力，但我们没有开。对现阶段的收竿来说，先让人用着顺手、愿意回来，比多一个变现入口更重要。

发布者把钓点设为「所有人可见」后，没有登录的人也能查看具体位置、直接导航。只是想看看别人主动分享的位置，不必为了这一步先注册。

钓点有三种可见范围：所有人、互相关注的好友、仅自己。愿意分享给所有人可以，只想和朋友交流，或者留作自己的秘密基地，也可以。

我们也在考虑这个问题。开发和维护都需要投入，社区得能持续做下去。

目前的设想是，等钓友和同城交流积累起来，逐步吸引钓场、周边商家入驻，通过服务商家寻找商业化机会。这是后续想尝试的方向，还不是已经跑通的模式。

社区功能继续免费，接下来很长一段时间，也没有接入广告的打算。

对你来说，记录出钓、找公开钓点、交流同城鱼情，哪个更值得留下来用？

不钓鱼的 V 友，也欢迎从产品体验和社区设计上提意见。

items.content:
一个球会掉下来。在其落地的地方进行贸易。

我做了这个游戏！一些技术细节：

整个落球过程都是在服务器端模拟的，然后作为服务器发送的事件通过一个小缓冲区传输到每个客户端。每一次掉落都是从其起始位置开始的，因此可以准确地重播回合以供以后分析，但起始位置的微小变化可能会改变最终结果。

有一些人工智能交易员来维持市场的运转，但他们在任何超过五人的回合中退出。他们使用我为他们编写的一套简单的规则进行运作，因此他们并不太难被击败——只有当市场充满真实的人时，事情才会变得棘手。

a ball will fall. trade on where it lands.

I made this game! Some technical details:

The entire drop of the ball is simulated server-side, then streamed to each client as server-sent events with a small buffer. Every drop is deterministic from its starting position, so rounds can be replayed exactly for later analysis, but tiny variations in starting position can change the ultimate outcome.

There's some AI traders to keep the market moving, but they drop out in any round that has more than five people. They operate using a naive set of rules that I wrote for them, so they're not too hard to beat -- it's when the market is full of real people that it gets tricky.

Curious to get feedback on anything you would change, and especially whether the mechanics were clear right away or not.

2026 年 11 月 27 日 · Codepoet · 社论

在分享该平台的最新创新成果时，我开始意识到有些人并不真正了解 webOS 是什么。我想我已经忍受了这么久，以至于我从来没有想到世界其他地方已经发生了变化。虽然我本来打算写一篇关于该平台未来的文章，但对于更休闲的探索者来说，也许对过去做一些入门是合适的……

早在 iPhone 出现之前，Palm Pilot 就已经是每个人都想拥有的“it”小玩意了。 Palm 自己的操作系统使这些设备变得有用且响应迅速，但到 2004 年，该公司及其平台都陷入了困境。人们开始努力重新构想两者，并创建了一个全新的“网络操作系统”，以与原始 iPhone 保持同步。

在 Apple 校友 Jon Rubinstein 的领导下，Palm 吸引了一些最优秀的设计师和开发人员（其中许多人甚至来自 Apple），通过利用 Linux、WebKit 和 JavaScript 等开放技术，在有限的硬件上创造流畅、美观的新体验。最初的带有滑出式键盘的 Palm Pre 继而推出了 Pre 2 和 Pixi，当时它们还是 Palm，但团队的英勇努力还不足以与 Google 和 Apple 抗衡。

items.originalContent:
27 November 2026 · by Codepoet · Editorial

In socializing recent innovations for the platform, I began to realize that there are people out there who don’t really know what webOS was. I guess I’ve lived with it so long that it never occurred to me that the rest of the world has moved on. While I had intended to write a post about the future for the platform, maybe a little primer on the past is in order – for the more casual explorer…

Long before the iPhone, the Palm Pilot was the “it” gadget that everyone wanted to have. Palm’s own OS made these devices useful and responsive, but by 2004, both the company and its platform were in a tough place. Efforts began to re-imagine both, and a completely new “web OS” was created to be contemporary of the original iPhone.

Under Apple alum Jon Rubinstein , Palm attracted some of the best designers and developers (many even from Apple), to create a fluid and beautiful new experience on limited hardware, by leveraging open technologies, like Linux, WebKit and JavaScript. The original Palm Pre, with its slide-out keyboard, was followed up by the Pre 2 and Pixi while they were still Palm, but the valiant efforts of the team were not enough to take on Google and Apple. They needed a new owner, with a bigger wallet.

HP decided they wanted to be that owner, and acqui-hired the Palm team . Work resumed on the diminutive Veer slide-out, the impressive Pre3, and the TouchPad tablet line under HP’s brand. The leadership promised webOS everywhere, and it looked like there might be a chance. The TouchPad launched against the iPad, with an updated version of webOS, innovative features that wouldn’t be copied by others for years, and a small but useful App Catalog… and then disaster struck.

HP had a leadership change, and foolishly decided to write off the Palm purchase . The dev team worked quickly to spin off a fully Open Source derivative, Open webOS , and accelerated efforts to make the SDK libraries usable cross-platform. The TouchPad went on fire sale , and most of the Pre3s never made it to market. The little group of innovators who dared to take on the Apple/Google Duopoly were defeated.

LG bought what was left of the commercial OS, and moved quickly to make it the platform for their Smart TVs. Other experiments, including a Smart Watch, only briefly glimpsed daylight. The Palm brand moved to TCL, and HP moved on to selling crappy Android and Windows 8 tablets. It seemed like the end…

But the famously active and dedicated Community weren’t willing to give up. webOS had been defined by Homebrew and the hacker ethos . Community members archived as much of the App Catalog as they could salvage before it was shut off. Open webOS was promptly picked up and became LuneOS – a community re-write that worked on the TouchPad and could be ported to other hardware. The TouchPad itself got some updates through Luna Community Edition, providing launcher features Palm never got to deliver.

Over the ensuing decade, though, the small contributions of the community were not enough to fight back the tide of progress. The ancient Linux kernel, WebKit and OpenSSH stacks became a challenge for the modern web. Previously open APIs that enabled apps and features got closed off as Meta and Google consolidated their iron-fisted control over our screen time. And app devs moved on to more profitable platforms.

In 2018, shortly before the world got shut down by Covid, I started work on restoring the SDK . I liked the fact that my TouchPad and Pre3 couldn’t do much – that meant Google wasn’t tracking my every move. It became a challenge to find a way to proxy, re-route, or update calls so I could keep apps alive, or restore them to functionality.

给 Android TV / 电视盒子写的开源 DLNA 投屏接收器 LeanCast 刚发了 v0.3.0。

一句话交代定位：它只做一件事，接收手机视频 App（B 站、爱奇艺、腾讯视频、优酷等）的 DLNA / UPnP 投屏并交给本机 MediaCodec 硬解播放。纯 Kotlin、无原生库，单 APK 5.5 MB 通吃各架构，无广告、不联网、零埋点。

这次 v0.3.0 是自 v0.2.7 以来改动最大的一版，核心集中在三件事：升级包名、重写电视端界面与播控 OSD、把之前代码审查挖出来的底层协议与并发坑集中清了一遍。

从 v0.3.0 起，应用包名从 io.leancast 迁到了 app.solocraft.leancast（对齐 solocraft.app/leancast）。

Android 会把新包名当成独立应用处理，装过旧版本的设备无法直接覆盖升级。如果旧版和新版同时留在电视上，两个进程都会监听局域网 SSDP 组播，手机投屏列表里会出现两个同名设备。升级前请先在电视上卸载旧版，再安装 v0.3.0。

旧版界面是早期凑合能用的状态：图标直接用的系统彩色 Emoji，在不同电视 ROM 上渲染完全不可控；暂停时屏幕正中间会弹出一个大黑框，刚好把底部字幕和画面挡住。

无遮挡暂停与矢量图标：用 7 枚纯色矢量图标换掉了所有 Emoji。暂停时取消中央弹窗，画面和字幕完整保留，只在右上角给出琥珀色暂停徽章，底栏进度条同步切为暂停状态。

客厅看片信息补全：顶栏右上角常驻客厅时钟（HH:mm）；切到非 1.0x 倍速或静音后，状态徽章会常驻顶栏提醒，不再切完就消失。底栏进度条改为双层轨道（可显示 ExoPlayer 实时的已缓冲进度）并加上键帽风格的遥控器按键提示。

首页状态与遥控器改名：空闲待命时不再残留上一部片子的旧标题；视频加载失败（比如防盗链返回 HTTP 403、网络中断或不支持的编码）会在首页直接给出诊断横幅，不再只甩一句笼统的错误。重命名弹窗加了 4 个遥控器快捷预设（客厅电视、卧室电视、书房投影、LeanCast），点选后焦点直接落到保存按钮，改名会即时重发 SSDP 通告且不中断正在播放的视频。

前阵子做了一次全量代码审查，顺带把 v0.2.8-beta.1 的自启改动一起合进来了，修掉几类平时不容易触发、但真碰上很难排查的问题：

items.content:
Poople 是最近在美国挺火的一个每日单词小游戏。每天给一个四个字母的单词，每次只能改一个字母，改完还得是个单词，最后变成 POOP，步数越少越好。不少人卡住了会去搜答案，所以我做了个答案站，页面是英文的。

答案默认盖住，点一下揭开一步。提示页只告诉你下一个词的首字母。还有个解题器，输入任意四个字母的单词，就能算出到 POOP 的最短走法。

第二天就有 Google 流量了。11 月 23 日那题从 TABS 开始，搜 tabs to poop poople 的人里我们排第 4，那天来了 42 次点击。

接下来两天就不行了。曝光还有七八百次，但排名掉到第 7 左右，点击变成 6 次和 1 次。我去搜了一下，排在前面的站给每个起始词都单独做了一个页面，标题和搜索词一模一样，比如 HULA to POOP。我的答案页是同一个网址每天换内容，比不过人家专门的页面。

进来的人行为倒挺一致。几乎都落在答案页，六成会点开答案，平均一个人点四下，一步一步看，一下全揭开的是少数。解题器几乎没人用。

另一个坑在词表。游戏没公开它认哪些词，大词表里的冷僻词会被拒，只留常用词又会漏。有一题我算出 10 步，游戏说 8 步，自己去走了一遍，才发现它认 ANDS 和 BODS。现在每天拿官方结果对一遍，越用越准。

想问问做过类似站的朋友，每天换题的内容，你们是用一个固定网址，还是每题单独一个页面？哪种在 Google 上表现更好？

items.originalContent:
Upstart engine gets downloadable macOS and Linux builds, but no security guarantees

The independent Ladybird web browser has reached an important milestone: an alpha test version. What's more, it works well. These may not be the criteria by which some will judge it, though.

Earlier this week, the developer behind the Ladybird web browser announced that Ladybird is now in alpha. We've given it a brief test, and it performed very well. It's more stable and works better than its alpha label would suggest.

There are downloads available, covering macOS on Apple Silicon, as well as for Linux on x86-64; for the latter, there's a Flatpak package, as well as native Ubuntu and Fedora packages.

It's an open source project, so you can download the source code from the GitHub repository and compile it yourself, but in an unusual move, back in June the project announced that the developers would no longer accept public code contributions.

We first mentioned Ladybird as part of our early 2022 look at its original parent project – SerenityOS: Remarkable project with its own JS-capable web browser. Both the name and the date are significant: the former is a nod to the Serenity prayer, recited at the end of Alcoholics Anonymous meetings. The date of the article is because it's well before the launch of ChatGPT at the end of 2022.

About a year and a half later, we reported that Serenity OS turns five and emits first offspring, Ladybird. Both the OS and the browser were still hand-coded, but now the browser could be compiled and run on other OSes. That freed it up to call upon external libraries which didn't exist for SerenityOS.

Earlier this year, we wrote Ladybird flutters toward Rust with a little help from AI. At one point, developer Andreas Kling used Apple's Swift language, but this year, he changed course and adopted Rust instead, using LLM tools to convert some existing code. Some will dismiss Ladybird because of this, but as our first coverage shows, the browser and its original host OS were established projects before the current wave of AI-assisted development.

Kling does use LLMs, but Ladybird is not some sloppy vibe-coded effort. The macOS download is 68.4 MB in size, which in 2026 is remarkably small. The Flatpak is larger – about 111 MB – but it also pulls in some KDE dependencies which increase its size.

We tested it on Pop!_OS. It handles sites such as The Register and Hacker News and everything else we tried perfectly, and took just 6 percent of our Dell XPS13's CPU to play full-screen HD video from YouTube smoothly. In our short testing, we saw no crashes, hesitation, or any other problems at all.
